target_rule: for j=0,1,2 compute k=1+int(SHA256(UTF8(seed+':'+p+':'+j)).hexdigest(),16) mod (q-1), then T=k*Qbar; require distinct k per cell; fixture construction is outside all arm intervals and hidden from solvers
target_input: public reduced point T only; scalar k is used solely for fixture and post-solve audit
rational_arm: fresh per-target scan of every nonzero (a,b) in [-B,B]^2 in frozen height-score order; construct exact rational aQ+bR, reduce and compare to T; after match return (a+lambda*b) mod q and independently verify
finite_control_arm: same coefficient order and target; compute ((a+lambda*b) mod q)*Qbar and compare to T without rational-point construction; return and verify matched scalar
rho_arm: same public point T; deterministic 3-partition Floyd rho with 64 restart seeds, up to 100000 iterations per restart, recording every walk update and degenerate collision; verify recovered scalar
online_interval: start immediately before first target-dependent candidate or walk computation and stop after scalar recovery and independent public-point verification; include failed attempts and restarts; exclude process launch, curve/pairing/label setup, lambda discovery, and fixture generation
status_policy: retain verified, candidate_cap_exhausted, rho_cap_exhausted, wall_cap_exhausted and error rows; no missing online cost is zero
host_tier: ordinary-host exploratory; preserve arm order and raw wall intervals; no Tier 0/1 speedup claim
